## Consequences

- **F1**: Drives global hydrothermal vent density; Sets baseline metabolic energy budget; Prevents total ice-shell collapse

- **F6**: Simplifies ecological zoning to vertical bands; Stabilizes ice-shell thickness globally; Removes seasonal breeding triggers
- **F7**: Dense medium transmits low-frequency sound efficiently; Increases fluid drag on locomotion; Requires pressure-equalizing internal anatomy
- **F8**: Maintains global liquid-water ocean; Creates stable thermal stratification; Drives continuous vertical convection cells

- **F11**: Creates vast anoxic benthic zones; Concentrates biomass around hydrothermal plumes; Enables deep-diving pressure-adapted megafauna
- **F12**: Shields surface from cosmic radiation; Limits surface energy to oxidant seepage; Drives chemosynthetic reliance on vent-derived reductants
- **F13**: Establishes localized high-energy oases; Drives chemolithoautotrophic primary production; Creates steep micro-gradients for niche specialization
- **F14**: Enables symbiotic H₂-grazing gut flora; Suppresses aerobic respiration pathways; Allows passive atmospheric nutrient uptake via specialized integument
- **F15**: Low background mutation rate stabilizes lineages; Selects for robust DNA repair mechanisms; Drives metallothionein detox pathway evolution
- **F19**: Modulates heat loss efficiency; Drives ice-ocean chemical exchange; Stabilizes global thermal gradients
- **F20**: Enforces benthic lifestyle for large organisms; Selects for TMAO and piezolyte accumulation; Limits vertical migration range
- **F16**: Metabolic rates are inherently slow; Favors ambush predation and energy conservation; Rapid metabolic surges risk protein denaturation
- **F17**: Biomass pyramid is flattened and vent-dependent; Energy transfer efficiency is low; Selects for large body sizes and slow growth
- **F18**: Membranes resist crushing depth and gas dissolution; Limits oxygen permeability, reinforcing anoxia; Enables pressure-equalizing swim bladder evolution
